AssetDesc.description: a read-only data slot of a module; a node binds an asset id to it, the host fills it at instantiation (ABI-V2 §1.5)

max_bytes.description: the largest asset the slot takes, in bytes (decoded)

AssetKind.description: what an asset slot holds once the host has filled it: planar f32 PCM, raw bytes, or a small RGBA8 image (ABI-V2 §1.5)

Attached.description: A rig carried at a spot of this rig's body.

spot.description: the spot of this rig's body it rides (`exhaust_left`: the model's `spot_exhaust_left`)

Background.description: One of a colour, an image or a video.

image.description: a picture's media path, laid over the stage

video.description: a video's media path, laid over the stage

Body.description: What a rig looks like on a stage: its own model.

height.description: how tall it stands, metres; none = its kind's card height

model.description: the model: a `.glb` by its CDN path from the root (`characters/takeyari-drum/takeyari-drum-regular.glb`)

module.description: the modules it plays: a code rig's policy (#408), a track's module (#430) – the `module:<id>` documents' descriptors

rig_preset.description: the rig's presets (`rig-preset:<id>` documents): what a scene's holder may play it on

Catalog.description: The catalog as a document: `kinds.json`. The API merges the published modules' descriptors into `kinds`.

Channels.description: an audio port's channel count; `any` = whatever the cable carries (§2.6)

oneOf.description: equal ratios per equal travel (frequencies, times, rates); min must be > 0

Descriptor.description: One node kind or module: what the engine, the validator, the editor and the agents all read.

abi.description: modules only: the ABI version they speak

assets.description: read-only data slots (samples, sequences, images) the host fills at instantiation

background.description: modules only: the stage's background while it plays, unless a rig, scene or show above it sets one

batch.description: the batch evaluator (deck-core batch.rs, live-core, the browser) can run it

characters.description:
modules only: the characters it is made for (`catpope`, a persona `yellowmouse.kid`) – their "related" modules; it
still plugs in anywhere

feature.description: the stage's cargo feature that carries the kind (`core` = always); empty = none

follow_transport.description: the kind follows the transport by default (#359: stops, holds, resumes with it); a node's `follow_transport` overrides it

latency.description: constant latency in frames, for the engine's compensation (ENGINE-REFACTOR-PLAN §2.6a)

module.description: deck-core's module for the kind (control · synth · analysis · stage · 3d …); empty = none

moods.description:
modules only (A1, #409): the moods the module knows, in its own order – the deck hands a module the mood's place
here + 1 as `mood_index` (0 = a mood not in the list; deck-space context.rs)

needs.description: capabilities the kind needs (#312): without one it does not run

reads.description: the show's variable slots the kind may read (`story.act` …, ABI-V2 §3)

scene_only.description: a scene owns it once: never inside an instrument

sections.description: modules only: its parameters' pages in order (area by area); none = they group by their names' prefixes

slot.description: modules only: the entity's slot it is built for (`camera.motion`, slot.rs); none = a rig's track module

wants.description: capabilities the kind uses when they are there (#312): without one it runs on, the sensor reads "absent"

DevicePreset.description: A device preset: the catalog document `device-preset:<id>` and an entry of the factory file.

buffer.description: frames per device period; none = the device's default

device.description: deck.toml's `audio_device`: a part of the device's name; none = the device the preset is recommended for

factory.description: one of the presets every deck ships with: read-only, only the factory file sets it

host.description: deck.toml's `audio_host` (default · asio · wasapi); none = the platform's default

name.description: what a person reads ('RME Fireface UCX II · ASIO')

origin.description: the preset this one was derived from

outlets.description: the outlet groups on the device's channels (deck.toml's `[[audio_outlet]]`)

Expose.description: A shown parameter: a control input `node.port`, its label, and a narrower range than params.rs's (optional).

FactoryPreset.description: a module's one factory preset (ABI-V2 §2); every other preset is a DB document (deck-space's rig `Preset`)

values.description: parameter name → value; a parameter not named keeps its default

Hardware.description: The hardware a preset is for: everything it names must hold for a device, and it names at least one thing.

channels.description: the output channels the driver reports

driver.description: the driver layer that lists it, lowercase: asio · wasapi · pipewire · alsa · coreaudio

names.description: parts of the device's name, any case: one of them is in its name or description ('Fireface')

expose.description: the parameters it shows; empty = every control input

out.description:
the track's output: an audio output `node.port` (a bare node = its `out`). None (#430): a silent track – a note
source (a step sequencer, a world node) with no strip and no outlet, wired by event cables

InstrumentKind.description: What an instrument is for – an Ableton track's role. A scene object's sound (#210) is an instrument too.

oneOf.description: noise, field recordings, an object's hiss (the incense)
an effect on a send / the master

map.description:
an audio link's channel map (plan 2.6, #318): `[source, target]` pairs counted from 1 – `[[1, 3], [2, 4]]` lands a
stereo source on channels 3 and 4 (a send's offset); one source may go to several targets, several sources into one
target sum. Empty = channel n to channel n. `scale` on an audio link is the send level.

Mapping.description:
A control source bound to a parameter. `source`: `midi:<channel>:cc:<n>` · `face:<blendshape>` (`face:jawOpen`) ·
`motion:<axis>` (`motion:tilt.x`) · `pad:<control>` (`pad:left.x`) · `stick:<left|right>.<x|y>`; its 0..1 (or −1..1)
lands on `target` across `range` (default: the parameter's range, params.rs).

Mode.description: how a control output with a `path` acts on its target (ABI-V2 §1.2, §5): replace it, add to it, scale it

OutletMap.description: The device channels an outlet group plays on, counted from 1, in the group's channel order.

choices.description: a string parameter's values (`osc.wave`); min / max / default are then unused

default.description: None = not driven until a param or a link sets it (an `events` node's knobs: the patch's own values play)

port.description: the value is also an input port of this name (a control input is both)

section.description: the page it sits on (`SRC/OSC 1`, one of the descriptor's `sections`); empty = none

slot.description: its knob on that page: 0 … 7, two rows of four (twin pages put one idea on one knob)

Policy.description: A rig's policy: the module that drives its tracks, the node's seed and its parameters' values.

module.description: the `module:<id>` document's id – its descriptor's name

seed.description: the node's seed (the module seed rule: 1 unless set)

values.description: its parameters' values by name (the rest keep their defaults); persona / mood values `policy:<param>` go on top

capacity.description:
event ports: records per block (1 … `MAX_EVENT_CAPACITY`); an instance table: the instances it holds (1 …
`MAX_INSTANCE_CAPACITY`)

channels.description: audio ports: how many channels the port carries

choices.description: control outputs: the value is an index into these names (an enum)

engine.description: false = deck-core's control graph (its `KindInfo`) does not take this input, e.g. the `cv` of `osc`

mode.description: control outputs with a `path`: how the value acts on the target

names.description: event ports: the deck-events names it emits / accepts (`music.note`, `story.act` …); interned once at load

path.description: control outputs: the target it writes (a group child's parameter, preset, gain …, ABI-V2 §5); empty = a graph cable

props.description: event ports: the positional meaning of the prop slots (at most `MAX_EVENT_PROPS`)

sidechain.description: audio inputs: a second input fed by sends, not by the graph's sum (ENGINE-REFACTOR-PLAN §2.6)

type.description: ABI v1 module descriptors call it `kind`

PortType.description: a port's type; a link joins ports of one type (`cv` = pitch / gate carried in an audio port, see `seq`)

oneOf.description: events out (deck-events' model): a module's notes and triggers, not a graph cable

a control module's instance table (shapes placed, turned, scaled, coloured) the space draws – an output, not a
graph cable (deck-module `instances`)

link.description: links added; one into an input that already has a link replaces it

mapping.description: control sources bound to parameters (#209, #212), saved with the preset

parent.description: the preset this one derives from (same instrument); none = a root

tags.description: free tags: a character's trait, a mood, a persona, a genre …

Rig.description: A character's (or object's) set of tracks.

attach.description: the rigs carried at spots of its body (body.rs), each a body part of its own

background.description: the stage's background while it plays, over its modules' and under a scene's or a show's

body.description: its 3D body: the model the stage draws where it stands (body.rs); none = its being

extends.description: the core rig it extends (`character.default`): that rig's tracks and routes play under this one's own (extend.rs)

moods.description: mood (the `moods` registry's ids) → overrides (applied after the persona's)

off.description: the extended rig's tracks turned off – not compiled at all, so they cost nothing (the built-in voice: `["voice"]`)

policy.description: a code rig (#408): the control module that drives the tracks (policy.rs); none = the tables alone

route.description: sends and modulation between tracks, and to the being's look (`being:hue`) – everything is audiovisual

sticks.description:
the two corner sticks of the phone deck, `[[x, y], [x, y]]` (left, right) as addresses of its knobs
(`<track>:<node>.<port>`, a code rig's `policy:<param>`; "" = none); none = the first four knobs (#191, #432)

subject.description: whose rig: `character.<id>` (`character.<id>.<persona>` for a persona's own) or `item.<id>` – KANON's subjects

factory.description: read-only: saving it makes a derived preset

id.description: `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`; a saved one's is `<rig subject>.<slug of its name>`

origin.description: the preset this one was derived from

rig.description: the rig it is for: its subject (`character.catpope`)

Right.description: What a holder may do (owner 2026-10-30: "the definition says who may save, copy or change it").

oneOf.description: save a derivative (a child preset) into one's carrier bag
save a copy without the lineage

Rights.description: Rights per way of holding, carried by every definition. Default: lent = play + tweak, core = + derive, owned = all.

Route.description:
`from` / `to` are `<track>:<node>.<port>`; `to` may be `being:<input>` (the space node's hue, glow, light, pulse).
Every sounding track reaches the master through its mixer strip; an audio route is a send into another track's audio
input (an fx track; `scale` = its level), a control route a modulation, an event route an event cable (#430: many to
many, a note source's silent track to a synth's track).

Scope.description: where a kind stands: usable in a scene / instrument graph, a helper only the batch evaluator runs, or planned

Section.description:
A named page of a module's parameters, the Analog Four's way: an area (one button, `SRC`) and one of its pages
(`OSC 1`; pressed again, the next). Descriptor metadata only: the parameters' order and the module's layout stay.

Track.description: One track: an instrument, its default preset, its mixer strip.

takes.description: the extended rig's track this one takes over: that one is off, this one plays in its place

Usb.description: A USB device's ids, where the OS reports them.

Variant.description: A persona's or a mood's overrides: another preset per track, and single values (`<track>:<node>.<port>`).
